description_en: Disables the automatic tablespace fragment recycling feature for database instances at a time
description_zh: 调用DisableAutoResourceOptimizeRules接口，批量关闭指定数据库实例的空间碎片自动回收功能
name: DisableAutoResourceOptimizeRules

parameters.help_en:
The database instance ID.

Set this parameter to a JSON array that consists of multiple instance IDs. Separate instance IDs with commas (,). Example: `['Instance ID1', 'Instance ID2']`
parameters.help_zh:
数据库实例ID。

数据格式为JSONArray，例如`['实例ID1','实例ID2']`，实例ID间用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: instance_ids
